rationale: Based on the Evaluator feedback and previous race data, I have made targeted adjustments to improve the robot's line-following performance. The integral gain ki is increased slightly from 0.18 to 0.2 to enhance responsiveness without risking oscillations, as the previous reduction to 0.18 may have slightly reduced responsiveness. The derivative gain kd is increased from 0.4 to 0.5 to provide better damping and reduce steering oscillations observed in prior runs. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2], increasing their magnitude moderately from [-1.0, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1.0] to strengthen the steering signal while avoiding excessive jitter. The base_speed remains at 1.4 to maintain progress speed without risking instability. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it showed promise in previous feedback. These changes aim to reduce steering oscillation, improve line recovery, and increase progress and completion rates. I request measurements including completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these adjustments in the next race.
